name: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Wash the tomatoes, remove tough stem sections and chop roughly into similar pieces. Rinse the basil and keep it aside for the finishing stage.
Warm olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the tomatoes and cook for about 8 minutes, stirring, until they soften and release their juices.
Add water, salt and pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for about 15 minutes, until the tomatoes collapse easily when pressed with a spoon.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool enough for your blender’s instructions. Blend carefully in suitable batches; do not seal very hot soup in a closed blender.
Return the smooth soup to the saucepan and stir in torn basil. Warm gently for a minute or two without prolonged boiling, then taste and adjust seasoning.
If too thick, add a little hot water; if too thin, simmer uncovered briefly before adding any extra basil. Serve when the soup has a smooth, pourable consistency.
tips: Do not seal very hot liquid in a closed blender; follow its safety instructions.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Ingredient costs are estimates. Check local prices before shopping.
